verdict.rationale: The docs show a product-specific CLI command, `vercel ai-gateway coding-agents setup`, used to connect supported coding agents. This means the official Vercel CLI has an AI Gateway subcommand. Beyond this one command line, the evidence pack has no documentation of the CLI's scope, other commands, installation or output formats. Missing for 10: documented CLI command reference, coverage of gateway operations beyond coding-agent setup (keys, budgets, logs, models), machine-readable/agent-friendly output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
